A custom greenhouse buildable by Robin. It comprises four 100x100 sections, totaling 40,000 tiles. Default cost is 10,000,000g and build time 28 days (both customizable). The map is simple with no extra decorations, occupying a 3x3 space. Its design draws on a small greenhouse from an existing buildable greenhouse mod, with artwork generated by AI.
